price_basis: split-adjusted, NOT dividend-adjusted (NU pays no dividend, so both bases agree). Regular session bars.
time_convention: Every date is an exchange trading date (America/New_York) and names the 1D bar of that session, never an intraday moment. Put the point on the bar whose date on the TradingView time axis equals this date; if the tool needs a timestamp, read it from that bar, do not build it from local midnight. After drawing, read each object back and confirm its bar date. 2026-11-13, 2027-02-22 and 2027-03-31 are trading days at or after the last bar in the data (12.11.2026); on 13.11 the bar may still be forming.
display_rule: primary (8): the three decision lines (trigger 13.00, invalidation, buy test 13.64), the nearest open gap above (GAP-1026, 13.00-14.57, also the first overhead zone), ONE S/R zone above inside that gap (the one with the most touches, nearest on a tie; zones that contain a decision line are carried by the line), the floor zone below (S-1120), the next report and the note. context (6): the zone around the trigger, the next two zones above, the next support below, and the post-gap anchored VWAP. hidden: everything else (drawn and hidden). Anchored VWAPs (evidence grade D) get no primary slot: the 8 slots go to decision lines, zones, the gap, the report and the note (grades A-C); spec 3.7 caps primary AVWAPs at one.
touch_rule: Over the 252 sessions ending 2026-11-12 (daily bars, CSV): a visit = a run of consecutive bars whose high-low range overlaps the zone; visits separated by fewer than 5 sessions outside the zone are one visit. A visit is a TOUCH when the close before it and the close after it are on the same side of the zone (entered and exited without crossing) and no close inside the visit is beyond the far edge. A visit that exits on the other side is a CROSS. A visit still open at the last bar is not counted.
gap_type_rule: Gap on day d (down gap: high[d] < low[d-1]; up gap: low[d] > high[d-1]). EXHAUSTION: the 20 sessions before d moved at least 3 ATR in the gap direction AND the gap was fully filled within 10 sessions. BREAKAWAY (if not exhaustion): the close of d is beyond the prior 20-session low (down) / high (up) AND volume[d] >= 1.5 x its 50-session average. AREA: every other gap. news = d is a report reaction session (Alpha Vantage report dates, all after the close) OR EWZ gapped the same way on d by at least 1 EWZ ATR (a Brazil-wide event). For a breakaway gap the near edge is an invalidation boundary, not a fill target.
zone_width_rule: width_atr = (price_high - price_low) / ATR14. Zones wider than 1 ATR would be split or dropped (none is). Zones narrower than 0.5 ATR are kept and flagged in width_note: a thin band where several kinds of evidence meet, not a 0.5-1 ATR zone.
round_number_rule: round_number = a whole-dollar price lies inside the zone or within 2 cents of it.
near_52w_high_rule: near_52w_high = the zone top is within 5% of the 52-week high.

relative_strength.sector_etf_reason: NU is a Brazilian digital bank (Brazil carries most of its customers and revenue; Mexico and Colombia are small): its sector is Brazilian financials, and EWZ (iShares MSCI Brazil, heavy in Brazilian banks) is the ETF in the data that carries that exposure. XLF is US financials, a different economy and rate cycle; it is shown for reference only. The 26.10.2026 gap was Brazil-wide (EWZ moved with NU).
relative_strength.definition: 12-1 momentum = adjusted close 21 sessions ago / adjusted close 252 sessions ago - 1 (skips the last month). rs_12_1_pct = NU minus the other, in percentage points. RS line = NU / other (adjusted closes); rs_trend: 'down' when the line fell over 63 sessions AND sits below its 50-session average, 'up' when both are the opposite, else 'flat'.

regime.rule: risk-on = SPY above its 10-month average (10 complete month-ends, Jan-Oct 2026) AND SPY 3-year return > 0 AND VIX < 20; risk-off = SPY below the 10-month average AND VIX >= 25; otherwise mixed. VIX bands: < 15 low, 15-20 normal, 20-30 elevated, >= 30 high.

rules_for_the_drawing_session: Draw only what this file lists, with these prices. Do not add trend lines, patterns, targets or stops.

This is a research map, not a trade plan. It contains no order, alert, position size or stop. Do not create orders or alerts from it. The trigger and invalidation lines are research conditions on a daily close, not orders.
Respect display: primary visible, context dimmed, hidden drawn and hidden. Do not promote an object.

Name every drawing object_prefix + id, e.g. NU-1113-R-1385. The name is the object-tree name, not the visible label. Indicators are not renamed. If the tool cannot set names, write a list of id -> TradingView object id in the session report so a later package can remove the set.
If a data_alignment_check is outside its tolerance, stop and report: the chart is on a different price basis.
